pages.text: Harvesters are used to automatically harvest fully grown crops. They run off of solid fuels and have an internal power storage buffer. $(br2)The harvester will automatically re-plant the crops it harvests. $(br2)The harvester will place all resources into it's internal inventory. If there's no space, the items will be placed on the crop.

pages.title: 조합
pages.text: The Harvester will use a bit of power every time it checks a crop for growth. Harvesting fully grown crops uses an increased amount of power. $(br2)These machines can upgraded with $(l:machines/machine_upgrades)Machine Upgrades$(). $(br2)The Harvester can be de-activated with a Redstone signal.
